title: From Target Selection to Digging: A Learning-Based Framework for Continuous Autonomous Excavation
summary: Repeated excavation continuously reshapes pile geometry, requiring an autonomous excavator to adapt its digging targets and coordinate motion across successive excavation cycles. We present a learning-based framework for continuous autonomous excavation that integrates terrain-aware target selection with reinforcement- and imitation-learning controllers.
